verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a local Unix-like terminal for iOS. Routing all device internet traffic through an exit node is a VPN/mesh-networking capability outside this product category, and nothing in the evidence shows a-Shell ships any such feature. Its networking mentions (nslookup, whois, a local relay server) do not route device traffic.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can route all my internet traffic through a specific device on my network using an exit node
